newsitem.title: USA: Total World says redeems 4 preferred issues.
newsitem.headline: Total World says redeems 4 preferred issues.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc said Friday it redeemed all of its outstanding preferred stock issued as Series U and W for a total amount of $10.2 million and series L and Z for a total amount of $3.9 million.

"This is another redemption of our various series of preferred stock that we have issued and used for short term financing needs," said chairman and chief executive Joseph Lents. "The company is pursuing several alternatives for additional sources of capital and the replacement of the Regulation S and D financings," he added.

Separately, the company announced it is launching its N'Touch product line in Dallas on Friday. The company said N'Touch sells 800/888 numbers which delivers telecom services that were traditionally delivered on multiple independent phone lines.
